executive_verdict.primary_failure_mode: Unbounded or repeated work, incomplete cancellation, and stale asynchronous state updates
executive_verdict.most_urgent_fix: Changes implemented; remaining environment and live-service validation is documented separately

scope.ui_constraint: No desktop source, layout, color, assets or style changes
scope.review_depth: Capability inventory plus targeted entrypoint/contract review and regression tests; not a line-by-line review of every backend file

findings.title: Canceled tools could still dispatch
findings.mechanism: The wrapper passed an already-aborted signal to implementations that need not check it.

findings.title: A deleted or disabled schedule could reappear
findings.mechanism: A stale handler completion wrote its old schedule back into the registry.
findings.recommended_fix: Fence schedule ownership and make task terminal states sticky

findings.title: Cosmetic repair multiplied model calls
findings.mechanism: Length formatting silently allowed two additional requests and discarded explicit output budgets.
findings.root_cause: Default repair budget and cap stripping
findings.recommended_fix: Use one request by default and preserve explicit budgets

findings.title: Stream errors could look like successful partial text
findings.mechanism: SSE failures, malformed frames and missing completion were not authoritative termination conditions.
findings.root_cause: Delta accumulation without complete terminal validation
findings.recommended_fix: Require terminal markers, propagate errors and release readers

findings.title: Memory compilation overwrote newer edits
findings.mechanism: A response generated against an old file was committed after an edit or reset.
findings.recommended_fix: Check outputs, reset marker and bookkeeping before committing

findings.title: Failed fact extraction could become a successful checkpoint
findings.mechanism: Repeated failures were marked processed, dropping pending information.
findings.recommended_fix: Keep the source dirty, isolate claims by store and back off

findings.title: Small contexts could repeatedly compact
findings.mechanism: Fixed 16K reserve and 20K recent history were unsuitable for smaller windows.
findings.root_cause: Budgets could exceed the model window
findings.recommended_fix: Scale reserve and recent context; cool down failed automatic compaction

findings.title: Memory recall could consume excessive context
findings.mechanism: Returned facts had no text budget and the advertised memory switch was not enforced at execution.
findings.root_cause: Unbounded response formatting and missing live gate
findings.recommended_fix: Bound excerpts, attach provenance and enforce the live switch

findings.title: MCP cancellation and body deadlines were incomplete
findings.mechanism: Signals were discarded between tool publication and transports, and HTTP timeout ended at headers.
findings.root_cause: Missing propagation and premature timer cleanup
findings.recommended_fix: Propagate abort signals, settle pending requests and cover body reads

findings.title: MCP stdout could grow without a complete frame
findings.mechanism: An unterminated stdout line accumulated indefinitely.
findings.recommended_fix: Reject frames above 8 MiB and close the connector

findings.title: Atomic writers shared one temp file
findings.mechanism: Separate writers could overwrite or rename the same .tmp file.
findings.recommended_fix: Use an exclusive per-writer temp file and clean it on failure

findings.title: Unused bridge SDKs loaded at startup
findings.mechanism: Reading Bridge metadata eagerly initialized Telegram and Feishu dependency trees.
findings.recommended_fix: Lazy-load SDKs while explicitly retaining their packaged dependency closure

ordered_fix_plan.why_now: Avoid duplicate effects and late state updates
ordered_fix_plan.expected_effect: Canceled work cannot dispatch new operations
Fewer cosmetic calls and bounded recall/compaction

ordered_fix_plan.goal: Preserve data and optional dependency closure
ordered_fix_plan.why_now: Runtime fixes must survive packaging and concurrent edits
Do not equate mocks with live services
ordered_fix_plan.expected_effect: Reproducible regression suite and honest validation record
